table.description: ServiceNow table, picked by the record number prefix: INC incident, CHG change_request, PRB problem, REQ sc_request (request), RITM sc_req_item (requested item), SCTASK sc_task (catalog task).

record_id.description: Record sys_id (32 hex characters) or record number, for example INC0010001, CHG0030002 or RITM0010001.

fields.description: Fields to change keyed by column name using raw values, for example {"assigned_to": "<user sys_id or user_name>"} or {"priority": "2"}. Use transition_record, not this tool, to change the state.
